tasks.check: deno check core/ sdk/ app/ eventlog/ scripts/ tests/core_test.ts tests/types.ts tests/errors_exhaustiveness.ts tests/unit/ tests/property/ tests/e2e/ perf/ingest_k6.ts
tasks.ci: deno task fmt:check && deno task lint && deno task check && deno task test && deno task test:prop
tasks.go:ci: cd server && test -z "$(gofmt -l .)" && go vet ./... && go test -race ./... && go test -tags noassert ./...
tasks.ci:all: deno task ci && deno task go:ci
tasks.perf:smoke: sh -c 'RUN_ID="${K6_RUN_ID:-k6-smoke}"; mkdir -p "logs/k6/$RUN_ID" && K6_RUN_ID="$RUN_ID" k6 run --out "json=logs/k6/$RUN_ID/raw.json" perf/smoke.js'
